title: Confirm Commons Text LCS after character-array copying
description: Check the original released score at bound four and unwind 18 on the final string implementation. Compare all 225 pairs on release, rebuilt source and shared-row control, and bind the raw checker measurement and original 120-second deadline.
expected: Retain the actual bounded checker statement, independent results, measurements and any first diagnostic.

steps.name: Check the verdict, raw bound and all three JVM tables
steps.run: python3 -c 'import json,sys,hashlib; from pathlib import Path; r=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()); assert r["native"]["verdict"]=="verified" and r["native"]["bounds"]=={"maxArrayLength":4,"unwind":18}; assert r["native"]["outcomeSha256"]==hashlib.sha256(Path(sys.argv[2]).read_bytes()).hexdigest(); assert {k:(v["pairs"],v["disagreements"]) for k,v in r["artifacts"].items()}=={"release":(225,0),"rebuilt":(225,0),"shared-row":(225,44)}' examples/308-commons-text-longest-common-subsequence/records/padding-checker-transfer.json examples/308-commons-text-longest-common-subsequence/records/padding-checker-native.json
